per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Routine interactions (browsing, searching, loading movie details) should respond within 5 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Checkout flow should take no longer than 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Initial streaming buffering should be single-digit seconds, and tolerable buffering should be no more than 10 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment data should be encrypted at rest and only accessible to a very small set of administrators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Role-based access control (RBAC) should be integrated with the identity provider, using least privilege, and make the admin UI audit every access.
A clear privacy notice should be shown before data collection and be visible in the footer on every page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Every sale should be logged in near-real-time, and usage metrics should be captured daily.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should detect anomalous patterns, rate-limit or block suspicious traffic automatically, and send alerts to the ops/admin team when something abnormal happens.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Admins should be able to generate batches of pre-paid cards, set denominations and expiration policies, and mark them as used when redeemed, with controls around creation and full logging of generation and redemption.
The system should use a microservices approach for user-facing APIs, with a CDN fronting static and streaming assets, and a separate payments service that talks to PCI-compliant payment processors.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All customer information will be stored on a secure database accessible only to authorized personnel.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Application logs, access logs, and security events should be centralized and retained for a few months, with daily usage stats feeding into analytics and dashboards and alerts for key health metrics.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Daily usage statistics should be logged and accessible by the administrator.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should be forgiving for novice users, with big, clear buttons, simple language, and a sleek African-inspired aesthetic.
